name: sourcemonkey
description: Userscript manager Chrome extension that treats userscripts like source code, built and managed with real coding tools

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/clean-stale-test-profiles.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && playwright test --project=sourcemonkey
scripts.test:e2e:tm: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/e2e-manager-preflight.mjs tampermonkey --need-closed && playwright test --project=tampermonkey --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:tm:headed: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/e2e-manager-preflight.mjs tampermonkey --need-open && TM_HEADED=1 playwright test --project=tampermonkey --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:vm: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/e2e-manager-preflight.mjs violentmonkey --need-closed && playwright test --project=violentmonkey --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:vm:headed: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/e2e-manager-preflight.mjs violentmonkey --need-open && VM_HEADED=1 playwright test --project=violentmonkey --workers=1
